labels: enhancement

---

## Problem
What's missing or awkward today? Link to the relevant part of `docs/` or `ROADMAP.md`
if this builds on something already noted there.

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see happen. If it depends on a backend contract that doesn't exist
yet, check `docs/API-Integration.md` and consider whether it should start as a typed
mock (see `docs/Architecture.md` §3) rather than waiting on the backend.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about and why you didn't propose them instead.

## Additional context
Mockups, related issues, links to prior art — anything that helps evaluate this.
